issue: दस अठा अठसठे चारे खानी इहै वरतणि है सगल संसारे — read in the traditional way: the eighteen Purāṇas, the sixty-eight tīrthas, the four sources of birth; this is how the whole world goes about (its religion).
our reading: The eighteen Purāṇas, the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage, the four sources of birth: this is the way of the whole world
alternatives: the Name pervades all of these (the whole creation)
